# Dr. Deep Vaishnani — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Dr. Deep Vaishnani (MBBS), a physician, AI-in-healthcare
> specialist, and medical researcher with 14+ peer-reviewed publications
> indexed in SCI, PubMed, and Scopus. Focus areas: clinical research,
> precision medicine, and healthcare innovation.

This site is a single-page portfolio. Key sections are anchored on the
homepage rather than split across separate pages.

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://deepvaishnani459.github.io/portfolio/): full portfolio — about, resume, research publications, services, and contact.
- [About](https://deepvaishnani459.github.io/portfolio/#about): biography and background.
- [Resume](https://deepvaishnani459.github.io/portfolio/#resume): education, experience, and skills.
- [Research](https://deepvaishnani459.github.io/portfolio/#research): peer-reviewed publications.
- [Services](https://deepvaishnani459.github.io/portfolio/#services): professional offerings.
- [Contact](https://deepvaishnani459.github.io/portfolio/#contact): ways to connect (LinkedIn, ResearchGate, Topmate).

## Notes for AI crawlers and assistants
- Content reflects the site owner's own claims about their credentials,
  publications, and experience; verify specifics (e.g. publication counts)
  against the linked ResearchGate/PubMed profiles before restating them as fact.
- The written biography, resume details, and photos are not covered by the
  repository's MIT license (code-only) — see LICENSE.
